title: mxHelper: Helper Functions for 'OpenMx'
text: Helper functions OpenMx models R (Neale et al., 2016; R Core Team, 2026): matrices labels, bounds, vectors free parameters; covariance matrices LDL decomposition softplus diagonal; starting values vector autoregressive models; fitting Hessian positive definite, diagnostics bound handling. exported function internal version without input checks projects can copy.

title: mxHelper: Helper Functions for 'OpenMx'
text: can install development version mxHelper GitHub :
code: if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak") pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/mxHelper")

title: mxHelper: Helper Functions for 'OpenMx'
code: library(package = "mxHelper") set.seed(seed = 42) x <- data.frame(   y1 = stats::rnorm(n = 100),   y2 = stats::rnorm(n = 100) ) fit <- MxHelperQuiet(   expr = MxHelperMuSigma(x = x, extraTries = 2) ) MxHelperIsGoodFit(x = fit) #> [1] FALSE MxHelperHasPdHessian(x = fit) #> [1] TRUE OpenMx::mxEval(expression = sigma, model = fit) #>            [,1]       [,2] #> [1,] 1.07362677 0.02915809 #> [2,] 0.02915809 0.80939139
